name: Intricate Blooms
desc:
A strange plant that coexists with kuuvahki energy, seemingly linked invisibly to certain nearby objects.
After absorbing the energy core of the Intricate Bloom, control the length of the connection between the energy core and the Intricate Bloom to rotate or move specific surrounding objects.

control the length of the connection between the energy core and the Intricate Bloom to rotate or move specific surrounding objects.

After rotating or moving to a specific location,
